precepts.text: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come. Remember we read in Isaiah 14, the king of Babylon. That great city Babylon, that mighty city. So their judgment comes in one hour.
precepts.point: Why does it say golden city? Because America is rich. Lucifer is talking about America. It is talking about a city, a country, rulers. It is talking about a government.
precepts.why:
“That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!” In the day the Lord gives us rest from our sorrow, our fear and the hard bondage we were made to serve in, we are going to be speaking against America. The king of Babylon here is America, and this is how we know Lucifer is not an angel: Lucifer is called the king of Babylon, the oppressor, the golden city. In Revelation it is mystery Babylon the great, and Revelation 18 explains that city.

“Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.” Remember what we read in Isaiah 14: the king of Babylon. Here it is that great city Babylon, that mighty city, and her judgment comes in one hour.

So Lucifer is a city, a country, rulers, a government. “The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.” It is not talking about a fallen angel; it is talking about America, the king of Babylon, whose ceasing Israel will proclaim when the Lord gives us rest from the hard bondage.

precepts.text: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. So great riches. That is the golden city.
precepts.point: Why does it say golden city? Because America is rich. Lucifer is talking about America. It is talking about a city, a country, rulers. It is talking about a government.
precepts.why:
Isaiah calls the king of Babylon “the golden city”: “How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!” Why does it say golden city? Revelation 18 explains it: “For in one hour so great riches is come to nought.”

So great riches: that is the golden city. It is called golden because America is rich. Lucifer is talking about America. And all those riches come to nothing in one hour, the same hour of judgment in verse 10, when they stand afar off crying, “Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city!”

The golden city ceasing in Isaiah is the great riches coming to nought in Revelation. It is not an angel that falls; it is a rich nation, a government, the oppressor that made us serve in hard bondage, and in the day the Lord gives us rest, we will take up this proverb against it.

precepts.text: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people. Come out of her, my people. Get your head out of Christianity. Get your head out of the philosophies. Get your head out of this thinking that your vote is going to mean something. You Israelites, you better get your mind right in terms of what the Most High is about to bring on this earth. The Lord said for us to gather ourselves together. Yea, gather together, O nation not desired. He is not asking in that scripture. He says, Gather together. That is a commandment. That is a direct order. He says, Gather yourselves together, O nation not desired. None of the nations desire us. None of them. So we are obligated to come together in righteousness. We are obligated to follow the programme in this Bible. That ye be not partakers of her sins. Zephaniah is saying the same thing, that ye be not partakers of her sins.
precepts.point: Flee out of the midst of Babylon. This is the same thing that is said in Revelation. These three scriptures are saying the same thing.

note.label: The Exponential Maturation In The Days Of Decadence

precepts.why:
Jeremiah says “Flee out of the midst of Babylon”, and Revelation says the same thing: “And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people”. Revelation, Zephaniah and 2 Corinthians are three scriptures saying the same thing.

Come out of her, my people. Get your head out of Christianity. Get your head out of the philosophies. Get your head out of this thinking that your vote is going to mean something. You Israelites, you better get your mind right in terms of what the Most High is about to bring on this earth.

“that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” That is the “be not cut off in her iniquity” of Jeremiah: don't be partakers of her sins, and don't be destroyed when that evil comes. Zephaniah is saying the same thing with “Before the decree bring forth”: so that you don't get caught up in the judgments. That's the point.

And the way out is the order the Lord gave: gather together, O nation not desired. He is not asking; that is a commandment, a direct order. None of the nations desire us, none of them. So we are obligated to come together in righteousness and to follow the programme in this Bible. We are in the time of the Lord's vengeance now, and coming out of her is how every man delivers his soul.

precepts.text: Come out of her, my people: out of Babylon. That ye be not partakers of her sins: whose sins do we not partake in? Edom's sins. The same way the sons of God should not partake in the daughters of men's sins back then that Noah was preaching to. It's the exact same thing all over again. And that ye receive not of her plagues: her plagues back then was water; her plagues now going to be fire. For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities: the Lord remembered Cain's too.
precepts.point: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word: the same word preached by who? Noah. Noah preached the same word to the people before the flood, and we're preaching to them before what? Kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men. The same word that was being preached by Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, Noah, to the wicked of our people mingled amongst the other people at the time: the flood came and killed them. That's what we're doing today: here we are back again, preaching to the same wicked sons of God mixed with the same people, before what comes? Fire. It's the exact same thing.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

precepts.why:
“And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people”: out of Babylon. Then, “that ye be not partakers of her sins”: whose sins do we not partake in? Edom's sins. The same way the sons of God should not have partaken in the sins of the daughters of men back then, when Noah was preaching to them. It is the exact same thing all over again.

And “that ye receive not of her plagues”: her plagues back then were water; her plagues now are going to be fire. That is Peter's warning, that the heavens and earth which are now are “reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.”

“For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.” The Lord remembered Cain's iniquities too. The scoffers say all things continue as they were, but God does not forget. As in the days of Noah, those who come out and do not partake of her sins will be saved, and those who stay will receive her plagues.

precepts.text: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down. Thy merchants were the great men of the earth: their corporations. For by thy sorceries were all nations deceived: the imagery, the television, the movies that manipulate the people, like the discussion earlier about images and enrollment. And do not think there are two different Babylons: this is the same Babylon the great.
precepts.point: Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured, even thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee. Everyone goes back to their homeland.
precepts.why:
Isaiah tells the virgin daughter of Babylon, “Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth.” God is telling you straight that this Babylon deals in witchcraft. Some might think they are clever and say there are two different Babylons. No: Revelation 18 shows it is the same Babylon the great.

“And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.” That is the same end Isaiah gives: “desolation shall come upon thee suddenly.”

“And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the great men of the earth.” The merchants are their corporations, the same merchants Isaiah names: “even thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.”

“for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.” By her sorceries all nations were deceived. That is imagery: what they put out in television and movies to manipulate the people, the way the Huxtables were an example. A film about the young George Washington dropped in theaters just this week, and it is not a coincidence: they want to bring the patriot spirit back for the 250th anniversary. It is witchcraft.

And she has laboured in it from her youth: 1776 is her youth, one of the youngest nations on the planet, with Washington DC laid out by the Freemasons in an upside down pentagram, the White House at the bottom point. That is the star some of our people wear while barbecuing on the Fourth of July, and they should be ashamed. Her astrologers and stargazers “shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them”, and Babylon is thrown down with violence.

precepts.text: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed; make America great again is not going to happen, America is falling.
precepts.point: Bread and circuses came before Rome fell; now it is a UFC fight on the White House lawn, the World Cup, weed legalized state by state to keep the mind docile, and sports with no breaks between seasons.
precepts.why:
Jeremiah speaks of Babylon: “We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed.” That is what they are trying to do now, in every aspect: heal America, just like the Bible says. Trump, make America great again, and all that. Listen, that is not going to happen. America is falling.

The Most High is showing it. America is about to celebrate its 250 years, and the front lawn of the White House looks shabby, the East Wing is under construction, the pool they spent all that money on is green with algae, and there is a fence around it all. When we were wicked in the world and had a birthday, we got a new outfit, a haircut, everything. Your 250th year should be something grandiose, and this is what your most pristine house looks like? Every picture shows it: a broken country. As in Daniel, the clay and the iron will never mix; everybody is going back to their own countries, and war is going to break out of this place.

Why can she not be healed? Because “her sins have reached unto heaven”. America made the biggest mistake of its life: it oppressed the children of Israel, the apple of God's eye, and even when we were supposed to be freed, it held forward the affliction and never opened the doors of its prisons. Because of her sins she keeps making the wrong decisions, hardening more and more towards us, and the Most High is taking note. There is a payment to pay, and no one can heal her.

precepts.text: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness. America has blurred the line between good and evil; sin is deceitful. Who blurs that line? Many a pastor on every corner facilitating the continuance of your oppression.
precepts.point: We must expose this evil so you can learn how to save your own soul. Look at what they call the young ones on the screen: our people smoking, toting guns, little kids with bullets bigger than they are. And then they call us a hate group when we are trying to stop the evil within our community first.

note.label: Called to Magnify the Law: Lord Increase Our Faith

precepts.why:
“Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” What are we coming out of? What this society promotes: adultery, the music, murder, sodomy, homosexuality, drunkenness, drug abuse, idolatry, wicked entertainment and corruption. All the things God hates, against his laws, statutes and commandments, and all of it deceives us. We must expose this evil so you can learn how to save your own soul. Look at what they call the YNs: our people smoking, toting guns, women with guns bigger than they are, little kids holding bullets. And then they call us a hate group when we are trying to stop the evil within our own community first.

Sin is deceitful, and America has blurred the line. Your president even asks, what do you have to lose? Choose the worst of both evils. Isaiah 5:20: “Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!” Woe is destruction unto them. That is how they blur the line between good and evil.

Who does that? Your pastor. Many a black church on every corner facilitates the continuance of your oppression. So you have to choose a side: righteousness, your heritage, your nation, keeping God’s commandments.

That is the second step: study, pray, apply, see yourself in the scriptures, and then show your faith by separating yourself from evil. Our purpose is Acts 26:18: “To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan unto God”. That is coming out of her.

precepts.text: For fire shall come upon her from the Everlasting, long to endure; and she shall be inhabited of devils for a great time. The she that is inhabited by devils is America. That great time goes into the thousand years; Revelation 20 goes into when hell gives up the dead and everything is destroyed.
precepts.point: Remember the demons that said, Art thou come hither to torment us before the time? That place of torment is going to be set up here after this place is destroyed physically.

note.label: Passover Class: Exodus From America Modern Day Egypt

precepts.why:
“The secret things belong unto the Lord our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us”. Moses understood that we would be brought into spiritual Egypt, America, and he saw America being destroyed. That is what Revelation 18 shows: “Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.”

What does hold mean? A hold is like a prison. After America is destroyed, America will become a prison, a cage. The demons that said, art thou come hither to torment us before the time? That torment is going to take place here in America.

Baruch 4:35: “For fire shall come upon her from the Everlasting, long to endure; and she shall be inhabited of devils for a great time.” The she that will be inhabited by devils is America. This place is going to be the place of torment, the prison of those same devils. When America is destroyed and Christ returns, he is going to set up a lake of fire, spiritual damnation, here in America for all the wicked.

“For a great time”: that great time is the thousand years. Revelation 20 goes into it, when hell gives up the dead and everything is destroyed. So Babylon becomes the habitation of devils, burning with a fire from the Everlasting that is long to endure.

precepts.text: The kings of the earth who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her: you did business with America, you got rich, you did America's bidding. They shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning, standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city, for in one hour is thy judgment come. It is the same wording as Esdras, and chapter 18 comes after the chapter 17 we just read.
precepts.point: They shall go stedfastly unto Babylon, that is America, and make her afraid. They shall come to her, and besiege her; the star (the missile) and all wrath shall they pour out upon her; then shall the dust and smoke go up unto the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her. Everybody around America is going to cry when they see it. Here is the precept.
precepts.why:
Ezra says “they shall go stedfastly unto Babylon, and make her afraid.” Babylon is America. “They shall come to her, and besiege her, the star and all wrath shall they pour out upon her”: the star is the missile. “Then shall the dust and smoke go up unto the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her.” Everybody around America is going to cry when they see it.

Here is the precept for it: “And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning.” The kings who committed fornication and lived deliciously with her are the ones who did business with America, got rich with her, and did America’s bidding.

They stand “afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.” It is the same wording as Esdras: the smoke going up, and those about her bewailing her. And Revelation 18 comes right after the chapter 17 we read, where the great whore and the city are shown.

Then “they that remain under her shall do service unto them that have put her in fear”: they become prisoners of war. That is the end of Babylon, America.

precepts.text: The kings of the earth bewail her when they see the smoke of her burning: alas, that great city Babylon, for in one hour is thy judgment come.
precepts.point: Strong winds from the east open it, the silos, and a horrible star with fire, hail and flying swords, the ballistic missiles, breaks down cities, walls, mountains and corn, and they go steadfastly unto Babylon, America, and make her afraid: God is going to make America afraid again. The nations, NATO among them, besiege her and pour out all wrath, the dust and smoke go up to heaven, all about her bewail her, as the kings of the earth in Revelation 18 cry alas that great city in one hour, and they that remain do service to them that put her in fear, prisoners of war.

note.label: Zionism in the Face of Syria & Hezbollah

precepts.why:
Ezra saw the clouds and the horrible star, the missiles, and then “they shall go stedfastly unto Babylon, and make her afraid.” Babylon is America. They talk about making America great again; God says he is going to make her afraid again. “They shall come to her, and besiege her”: it will not be a one-on-one fight. The nations, NATO among them, will besiege America and pour out all their wrath upon her. “Then shall the dust and smoke go up unto the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her.”

Revelation tells the same thing: “And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning, Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.”

The smoke that goes up unto heaven in Ezra is the smoke of her burning in Revelation. The ones about her that bewail her are the kings of the earth who lived deliciously with her, standing afar off in fear. Her judgment comes in one hour.

Then “they that remain under her shall do service unto them that have put her in fear”: prisoners of war. And the party is not over. After the fall of Babylon, the Lord bends Judah for him, fills the bow with Ephraim, and raises up the sons of Zion against the sons of Greece.

precepts.text: Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins nor receive of her plagues: God has told you who is conspiring and what to do, and his people are Israel.
precepts.point: Fear not, I will bring thy seed from the east and the west and say to the north, give up. Everyone called by my name I created for my glory; let the nations bring their witnesses, ye are my witnesses, and beside me there is no saviour. All the destruction is to set the twelve tribes back in their place.
precepts.why:
“I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.” The Lord gave other nations for us: he brought blood and destruction on their heads on our behalf. “Since thou wast precious in my sight”, not yellow, black and white all precious in his sight like the Christian song says, but the twelve tribes, “therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.” He didn't say he would spare the little Arab kids or the Israeli kids planted in the land. Revelation shows how much he loves us in the middle of that.

He has put it in front of us in prophecy: what is about to go down, where it is going down, who is involved and who is conspiring against Israel, and the parts they will play. He has told us not to meddle with them, and he has told us what to do to secure our salvation.

“And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people.” Who are his people? According to Isaiah 3:12, children are their oppressors and women rule over them; only the southern kingdom and northern kingdom have that problem. So he is letting you know it is only Israel.

“That ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” Don't be part of the sins and the plagues coming on this place, the land of the north where Esau dwells, or in the valley of decision where everybody is gathering for the great day of Armageddon. Don't receive the death and destruction on the way when the Most High shows up.

So your fight is not with the nations. Your fight is with getting yourself together, working on your salvation, so you can see the promise made to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

precepts.text: With violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and in her was found the blood of prophets, of saints and of all that were slain upon the earth: the prophets and saints will be killed in America, and she is the cause of all the earth's slain, as angels worked with Nebuchadnezzar's army in Ezekiel 9.
precepts.point: As Babylon caused the slain of Israel to fall, at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth: America is responsible for every war on the earth, whichever president sits, and the Russia-Ukraine war began with America dangling NATO before Ukraine and then walking away.
precepts.why:
Christ said there shall be wars, famines, pestilences and earthquakes before he returns, and Jeremiah shows who is behind the wars: “As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.” Because Babylon killed the saints, America will be responsible for all the wars and deaths taking place on the earth. It is the Lord bringing these plagues, but he is using Babylon, America, to do it. No matter which president goes into office, he will do what God wants him to do. The Russia and Ukraine war began because America kept dangling the carrot of NATO before Ukraine, promising to protect it from Russia, and then Trump came in and said we ain't helping you with nothing.

John saw the end of it: “And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down”. That great city Babylon is America.

“And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.” The prophets and the saints will be killed here in Babylon, and all the wars and death on the earth, Babylon will be the cause of it: America, the oppressor.

It is the same as ancient Babylon. Nebuchadnezzar came through killing everybody, but who was behind him? The Lord. In Ezekiel 9, when the mark was set on those that sigh and cry and the rest were slain, children and all, it was not literal angels alone; it was angels working with Nebuchadnezzar's army. So too America fulfils God's prophecy, whether openly like Trump or in secret like Obama killing Gaddafi, and over thirty-eight million people have been killed by America's policies and wars since 1971. Billions will die in what is about to take place.

precepts.text: Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins. Come out of religion, Christianity, and the philosophies and deceit, and repent.
precepts.point: But rather that ye may prophesy. That is why the class deals with prophecy first. A captain adds that the purpose of prophecy is to build your spirit and prepare you for temptation and destruction; when you see these things come to pass, know that Esau, Edom, America, is the enemy the Bible speaks of.

note.label: Mindset Of A Leader, Actions Of A King

precepts.why:
“but rather that ye may prophesy”. The purpose of prophecy is to build your spirit up and prepare you for temptation and destruction. Prophecy is warning: thus saith the Lord. When you see these things come to pass, know that Esau, Edom, America, is the enemy the Bible speaks of.

Revelation 18 gives the warning plainly. Babylon the great is fallen and has become the habitation of devils, and the call goes out: “Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.”

Come out of religion. Come out of these doctrines. Come out of Christianity. Come out of the lies and philosophies and deceit, and repent. The Christian church has you clapping on a tambourine while the prophecy is fulfilled before your eyes; they say the book of Revelation is sealed and cannot explain any of this.

That is why we covet to prophesy: so our people can see who Babylon is, come out of her, and not receive her plagues when the fire comes on her.

precepts.text: Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, said twice because Israel is the little Babylon, and is become the habitation of devils. All nations have drunk of the wine of her fornication, her policies, the craft of Daniel 8:25; the kings committed fornication with her and the merchants, the corporations, waxed rich. Come out of her, my people, tells you where the twelve tribes are: in Babylon, here, not Iraq.
precepts.point: The woman is that great city which reigneth over the kings of the earth. God calls it a city; we call it a country. Nobody dominates America; America reigns over everybody.
precepts.why:
Revelation 17 ends with the woman: “the waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.” Put up the Statue of Liberty: Lady Liberty sits upon many waters; she is everywhere. The ten horns, Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Germany, the United Kingdom, Italy, Greece, France, Denmark and Ireland, “shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.” It will be an ambush; the entire country will be destroyed. “And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.” We call it a country; God calls it a great city. Nobody dominates America; America reigns over everybody.

Then chapter 18 opens right after: “Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.” Why does it say fallen twice? Because Israel is the little Babylon.

“For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication”: her policies, the same thing Daniel 8 says, that through his policy he shall cause craft to prosper. All nations follow their policies. “And the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her”: the nations got in bed with her. “And the merchants of the earth”, the corporations and companies, “are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.”

“Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” That lets you know where the Israelites are: in Babylon. They say Babylon is Iraq. No, no, no: it is letting you know the twelve tribes are here.

precepts.text: She saith in her heart, I sit a queen and shall see no sorrow. If you think no harm will come to you in your sins, Amos 9:10, you have Edom's characteristic. You cannot get salvation unless she is destroyed, so remaining in your sins means you want America to continue. This is for the brothers and sisters who fade and always have something more important.
precepts.point: I will bring plagues upon the world, the sword, famine, death, and destruction, for wickedness hath exceedingly polluted the whole earth and their hurtful works are fulfilled. Esau did that: Malachi calls Edom the border of wickedness, and 1 Maccabees 1:9 says after Alexander's death evils were multiplied in the earth, from the Greeks through Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Britain, Russia, and America.
precepts.why:
The earth is polluted with wickedness, and Babylon is at the center of it. “How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.”

America really thinks it will never have to pay for its crimes. So if you are sitting in your sins thinking, as Amos 9:10 says, that no harm is going to come to you, you have a characteristic of Edom, the same characteristic as Esau. If we want deliverance, why would we have that mentality? We cannot get salvation unless she is destroyed. So if you want to remain in your sins, you want America to continue.

This is for the brothers and sisters you barely ever see, because they always have something more important than the truth; the ones who fade, and nobody hears from them. This is a gut check, so you can get your mind right. Some of you have embodied the characteristics of America, and it is time to shake that off.

A lot of us look at America as a gorgeous, beautiful woman and are mesmerized. But she is the mother of harlots, and just because you are not picking up a prostitute does not mean you are not out there dealing with harlots. She lives deliciously and thinks she will see no sorrow, but so much torment and sorrow will be given her. Come out of her.

precepts.text: Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins and receive not of her plagues. Mystery Babylon, mother of harlots and abominations. The Lord is still sending plagues, remember the pandemic; come out spiritually so that is not your condemnation.
precepts.point: Stumble not at the beauty of a woman, and desire her not for pleasure. Many of you see America as a gorgeous woman and are mesmerized; every pleasure is available in her. Many brothers fall by harlots, and you do not have to pick up a prostitute to be dealing with the mother of all harlots.
precepts.why:
She says in her heart, “I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.” Some of y’all have taken on the characteristics of America, and it is time to shake that off. She is “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH”, and an abomination is what the Lord hates and despises. So it is time to come up out of her.

“And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.”

That ye receive not of her plagues, because the Lord is still sending plagues. Y’all remember the pandemic. Stay with the Lord and come up out of her spiritually, so that her condemnation is not your condemnation.

That is what it means not to stumble at the beauty of the woman: don’t be mesmerized by her or desire her for pleasure, but come out of her, because her judgment is coming.

precepts.text: Why is earth and ashes proud? There is not a more wicked thing than a covetous man, for such an one setteth his own soul to sale, because while he liveth he casteth away his bowels. Oprah did not get all that money for being a great host, and the athletes did not get those contracts just for talent.
precepts.point: Revelation 18:3: all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, the same wine of Habakkuk 2:5, her policies; the kings of the earth, presidents and prime ministers, committed fornication with her, and the merchants waxed rich through her delicacies.
precepts.why:
“And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more”. The merchants are the corporations that make major deals with countries. The gold, silver and precious stones come this way by ship in those big containers, and the majority of what is listed comes from the continent of Africa. Then: “and slaves”: that was you and me. “And souls of men”: you want a piece of the pie, you have to sell your soul. There are things you must do.

Ecclesiasticus says it: “Why is earth and ashes proud?” Earth and ashes represents man; why is man proud? “There is not a more wicked thing than a covetous man”. They covet what does not belong to them. If you are covetous, you want a piece of the American pie, those billions of dollars in contracts. “For such an one setteth his own soul to sale; because while he liveth he casteth away his bowels.” While he lives he casts away his bowels, the lower intestine, the rectum.

You think Oprah got all that money just because she was a great talk show host? You think LeBron and these athletes got those contracts because nobody is as good as them? Michael Jai White is a good actor, but there are certain things he said he is not going to do, so he does not get those contracts. Ye said, if you see a video of me with a goat, because he knew what they held over him. They have something on all of them. The model from our Houston school, the Black Starlet who found a line of producers at the door: to get the contract you cast away your bowels.

That is why Paul says “they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.” Covetousness is the last of the ten commandments, and it starts in the mind; covet and you will steal, steal and you will lie, and it goes on to murder. The fear that keeps them from repenting is being publicly humiliated for what they did to get their fortunes, the way they destroyed Wendy Williams. But the Lord can still preserve the soul: come out of that lifestyle.

precepts.text: Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins. God hath remembered her iniquities; reward her double according to her works. Come out of the ways and idolatry of America, or receive the same judgment.
precepts.point: I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should ye be utterly unpunished? That is Venezuela, Cuba, IUIC in America, and now US troops heading to Nigeria. The Lord judges us first, and the judgment of the nations follows: a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
precepts.why:
“For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name”. That is what you see now: what is happening with Venezuela, with Cuba, with ICE here in America, and now the US sending troops to Nigeria. The Lord is bringing evil upon his people first. “and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth”. If the Lord is judging us, understand that the judgment of the nations is soon to come.

But if we do not get rid of the idolatry, the same judgment America gets, we would get. So the voice from heaven says, “Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” Come out of the ways of America. Come out of the idolatry.

“For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.” Edom thinks God has forgotten. The Lord remembers every last iniquity, every atrocity, every abomination they have committed. “Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.”

So if we do not repent of the stubbornness, the bullheadedness and the idolatry, we will get the same judgment. That is why we keep hitting these streets, blitzing, travelling and doing the work of the Lord to wake our people up and bring them out of her.

precepts.text: Thou shalt serve thine enemies in hunger, thirst and nakedness, and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck.
precepts.point: The merchandise of Babylon runs from gold and timber to slaves and souls of men. The countries of Israel are not underdeveloped but overexploited.

note.label: Raising Cain: The Son of Perdition, Merchants, and Captive Nations

precepts.why:
Babylon's merchandise runs from “gold, and silver, and precious stones” down to “slaves, and souls of men.” The tin, the copper, the iron, the rubber, the bauxite, the slaves and the cheap labor have all been taken out of our countries. These countries are not underdeveloped; they are overexploited. They all should be rich countries, world powers, with the blessings the Lord gave us in those places. It was done in Latin America and in Africa, especially the west coast where we are dispersed, and the slave routes and trade routes were the commerce they made of us.

The way they keep that dominance today is economic, backed by the threat of military power, and it follows a pattern, as with Noriega and now Maduro. First they criminalize the leader with drug, terror and corruption narratives, framing mischief by a law. Then they declare the regime illegitimate. Then they apply sanctions and economic siege. Then they isolate the country diplomatically and militarily, remove or extract the leadership, and install or manage a transition authority.

The sanctions are the modern face of Deuteronomy 28:48, for those who say the curses were only for back then or only for the time of the conquistadors: “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things”. Want of all things because of sanctions and their economic might. If you try to nationalize your resources or do things outside of their money, even though you have your own resources you are overexploited to the point that you cannot do it on your own. There is no might in your hand.

“and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” A lot of times we did this willingly. It is the same pattern we followed with Assyria and Egypt: when the United States became a world power we leaned on them, and found out really quick that they do not keep their word on anything. It is history repeating itself, the doctrine of the scripture executed over and over again.

precepts.text: I know thy poverty, but thou art rich; and the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews and are not.
precepts.point: The merchandise of Babylon runs from gold and timber to slaves and souls of men. The countries of Israel are not underdeveloped but overexploited.

note.label: Raising Cain: The Son of Perdition, Merchants, and Captive Nations

precepts.why:
“I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich).” First and foremost, the riches are the promise of the kingdom of heaven. Unto us pertain the promises, the law, the adoption of sons, all of it; we are the ones Christ died for. That is the true riches.

But Revelation 18 gives it a new spin. Babylon trades in gold, silver, precious stones, fine wood, iron and marble, and these come out of our lands. So-called third world countries are rich with resources; it is the people who are poor, because they are overexploited. What a distinction. The countries of Israel are not underdeveloped, and the poverty of our people sits on top of the riches of our lands.

“and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.” Those who say they are Jews and are not are part of the same machine working to oppress our people, and it is the same playbook of sanctions, isolation and regime change that runs through the whole system.

So Revelation 2:9 stands beside Revelation 18:12: the merchants of Babylon grow rich off the goods of the lands where Israel is scattered, while Israel lives in tribulation and poverty, though rich in the promises and in the land itself.

precepts.text: Alas, alas that great city Babylon! for in one hour is thy judgment come.
precepts.point: Loss of children and widowhood shall come in one day for the multitude of thy sorceries. Thy wisdom and knowledge have perverted thee, and thou hast said, I am.

note.label: Donald Trump: the Sword of God

precepts.why:
“Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon.” Babylon, America, is up on high, a proud nation, and God says he will bring her down. “thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate”, because the prophets will be revealing this devil to his face on the streets, and the world is going to know this is the man of sin, the son of perdition. “uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh”: take off that head covering; you are no righteous woman, you are a hoe. “Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance.”

“But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood.” Death and fire are coming to Babylon, “for the multitude of thy sorceries”: the evil America perpetrates throughout the earth, the LGBT, the murder, the colonization, the imperialism, the genocides.

Is “in one day” read elsewhere? Revelation 18: “Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.” That great city Babylon is America, that mighty city no other nation could defeat. In one hour, in one day, her judgment comes.

That one-hour judgment is coming for America. What are you going to do about it? Are you going to survive it? Are you going to put in the work, change your life and repent, or keep playing games because you think you have a little more time?

precepts.text: I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute.
precepts.point: The merchants weep for the gold, spices, oil and slaves that came from the dark nations. In her was found the blood of prophets.

note.label: Donald Trump: the Sword of God

precepts.why:
“Come out of her, my people.” Come out of America’s ways, come out of their filth, and do not partake in the sins of Babylon, “that ye receive not of her plagues.” Babylon is America, and “God hath remembered her iniquities.” For all the bombs she dropped on the nations of the earth, the Lord says “double unto her double according to her works.” She “lived deliciously” on the resources, the minerals and the strength of the dark nations, particularly Africa; and among her merchandise are “slaves, and souls of men”, the Israelites. Our people’s soul is knit to America; they want her to last forever.

Then: “in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.” Where are the prophets? Right here. You are the prophets, you are the saints, in Babylon which is America.

Luke 11:49 proves it: “Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute.” God sends his prophets and apostles, and some of them are slain and persecuted. That is the blood found in Babylon.

So come out of her, because her judgment is coming: “in one hour is thy judgment come.” And when Babylon is destroyed, what do you do? “Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.”

precepts.text: Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double.
precepts.point: The merchants of the earth wept over her gold, silver and precious stones, and the souls of men.

note.label: Babylon Speaks Plainly: Venezuela and the Real WMD

precepts.why:
“Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils”. This is once Christ comes to redeem us; we read something similar in Isaiah, and the Bible is repetitive and supports itself. “For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication”: that is Bretton Woods. If America collapses, all of them collapse; that is the way they wound it. It wasn't only us that made a covenant with death. The kings of the earth married themselves to America's success through the IMF and the banks, and that money is the real weapon of mass destruction. So all the posturing when they talk against each other is BS. America can't fail until God makes it fail.

Then “Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” Because of her sins we are in these situations, as we read in Hosea and Lamentations, so we have to come out of her. “For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.”

“Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.” That is assured reciprocity; that is the recompense. “How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her”, for she says “I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow. Therefore shall her plagues come in one day”.

The merchants weep because they are all tied to her: what are we going to do now? The gold, silver, precious stones and the rest come from Africa, Latin America, wherever our people are, and “slaves, and souls of men”: the trafficking. The horses and chariots are the weapons they sell to other countries in US dollars. They have complete authority because they run the money. But the Lord will judge her double, and from that point on it is our time. Our power is to repent: not attack any government, but obey the powers that be and build back our community and economy with each other.

precepts.point: This is fulfilled in the destruction of Babylon: rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets, for God hath avenged you on her. Babylon the great in this teaching is the United States of America; that is where the Lord makes his arrows drunk with blood, the vengeance promised for all the wrong these nations have done unto us.

note.label: Deuteronomy 32: The Song of Moses, Prophecy of Israel's Fall and the Most High's Vengeance

precepts.why:
The vengeance of the song is fulfilled in the destruction of Babylon: “Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.” The holy apostles and prophets whose blood was shed, Christ, James, Peter and the rest, are avenged on Babylon, and heaven is told to rejoice, just as the song says “Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants”.

Babylon the great in this teaching is the United States of America. That is where the Lord makes his arrows drunk with blood, the vengeance promised for all the wrong these nations have done unto us, and after it he “will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.”

precepts.text: In her (America) was found the blood of prophets and saints and all that were slain upon the earth.
precepts.point: The Most High will not forget what has happened to the children of Israel; he will avenge our blood. All we must do is walk in righteousness, keep the commandments, and have faith in the son Jesus Christ while the Lord revenges the blood that has been shed.

note.label: Psalm 9: I Will Praise the Lord With My Whole Heart

precepts.why:
“When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them”. Where is that blood found? “And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.”

In her, America, was found the blood of prophets and saints and all that were slain upon the earth. The Most High will not forget what has happened to the children of Israel here; he will avenge our blood when he makes inquisition for it.

So we do not take vengeance ourselves. We walk in righteousness, keep the commandments and have faith in the son Jesus Christ, and the Lord who dwells in Zion remembers the cry of the humble and revenges the blood that has been shed.

precepts.text: The kings of the earth who committed fornication with Babylon bewail her.
precepts.point: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness. He trusted in his slave trades and his riches.

note.label: Psalm 52: The Boasting Man of Sin Revealed

precepts.why: “Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.” He trusted in his slave trades and his riches. Revelation shows where that trust ends: “the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning”. The kings who fornicated with Babylon and lived deliciously with her will bewail her when the riches burn.

precepts.text: Standing afar off for fear of her torment, saying, Alas, that great city Babylon, for in one hour is thy judgment come.
precepts.point: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness. He trusted in his slave trades and his riches.

note.label: Psalm 52: The Boasting Man of Sin Revealed

precepts.why: They stand “afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.” The man who trusted in the abundance of his riches and strengthened himself in his wickedness sees his mighty city judged in one hour. All the riches from the slave trades could not make God his strength, and the kings stand afar off in fear.

precepts.point: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness. He trusted in his slave trades and his riches.

note.label: Psalm 52: The Boasting Man of Sin Revealed

precepts.why: “And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more”. The riches he trusted in were built on merchandise, and when no man buys it any more, the merchants weep and mourn. This is the man that made not God his strength: when the trade stops, his strength is gone.

precepts.why: The merchandise is listed: “gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory”, and vessels of most precious wood, brass, iron and marble. Purple represents royalty, and we no longer buy purple from the white man. The abundance of riches the mighty man trusted in is this merchandise, and the merchants mourn because no man buys it any more.

note.label: Psalm 52: The Boasting Man of Sin Revealed

precepts.why: “And cinnamon, and odours, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.” At the end of Babylon's merchandise are slaves and souls of men. Israel was the first commodity on Wall Street. That is the slave trade the man of Psalm 52 trusted in, the abundance of riches he strengthened himself in his wickedness with, and it is what the merchants weep over when the judgment comes in one hour.

precepts.text: Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins and receive not of her plagues; come out of Babylon.
precepts.point: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war. With his smooth policies, politics, religion, and lies our people believe him, but war is in his mind, designed to destroy us secretly, the same as was done to the Indians. We are to live peaceably with all men if possible and rely on the law of this Bible.

note.label: Psalm 120: In My Distress I Cried Unto the Lord

precepts.why:
“Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” Come out of Babylon. Our soul has long dwelt with him that hateth peace, Esau, Edom, the daughter of Babylon, and the Most High calls his people out of her so that we do not share her sins or her plagues.

That is the answer to “Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!”

precepts.text: Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins and receive not of her plagues.
precepts.point: Israel and Judah have not been forsaken of the Most High. Flee out of the midst of Babylon and deliver every man his soul; do not be cut off in her iniquity, for this is the time of the Lord's vengeance.

note.label: Jeremiah 51: The Full Recompense of Babylon

precepts.why:
“Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” It is the same voice as Jeremiah's: “Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity”.

Israel and Judah have not been forsaken of the Most High, “though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.” Because he has not forsaken us, he calls us out of Babylon before her plagues come, “for this is the time of the Lord’s vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.” Stay in her and you partake of her sins and receive her plagues; come out and deliver your soul.

precepts.text: Every shipmaster and sailor stands afar off and cries at the smoke of the great city's burning, casting dust on their heads and lamenting how in one hour so great riches came to nought.
precepts.point: They shall take up a lamentation, asking how she is destroyed, that renowned city inhabited of seafaring men which was strong in the sea and caused terror on all who haunted it. This parallels the fall of the great seafaring city that reflects Esau's nation today.
precepts.why:
At the fall of Tyrus “all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes”, clothe themselves with trembling and sit upon the ground astonished, taking up a lamentation: “How art thou destroyed, that wast inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in the sea”. Revelation has the same scene at the fall of the great city. “For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off, And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like unto this great city!”

They cast dust on their heads, weeping and wailing: “Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.” Seafaring men, renowned in the sea, made rich by her, lamenting her in one hour.

That is the parallel. The fall of Tyrus, the great seafaring city, reflects the fall of Esau's nation today. The isles tremble in the day of her fall, and the isles in the sea are troubled at her departure.

No man might buy or sell: this shows what it is talking about. Some of these Israelite camps say it means you won't be able to buy a Snickers bar, you have to get a microchip to buy Snickers. It ain't talking about that. “And the merchants of the earth” The merchants of the earth are world corporations, their firms; not Pooky and Ray Ray on the corner, not a candy store. They do world business; it ain't talking about you going to the grocery store. “shall weep and mourn over her;” Over Babylon being destroyed. “for no man buyeth their merchandise any more:” No man buying their merchandise any more.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 8 A Star Called Wormwood

precepts.why:
What is the outcome for this great mountain, this destroying mountain? Notice it gives different descriptions for America: one place calls it Babylon the great, another place the great mountain, another O destroying mountain. “And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory. And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen,” John is seeing the destruction of Babylon the great, the destruction of the United States of America. That ain't treason talk, this is Bible talk, for you people online saying they're speaking treason. No: this is what the prophecies say and what is going to happen to this place. Babylon the great is that great mountain we read about in Revelation 8. “is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.” That is making reference to the unclean spirits and animals that will be remaining here; Isaiah 34 says the same thing, a little more descriptive.

“For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her,” Her fornication is going into their policies, their political policies. “and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.” Write that down: merchants means corporations.

“And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people,” Christian commentaries say this Babylon is Rome. This ain't Rome; verse 4 is the key: come out of her, my people. Where would God's people be? Are we over there in Rome? You might find five black people in Rome. “that ye be not partakers of her sins,” This place is filled with sin, and we have assimilated to be part of the sins of America. This is why we want to be actors and actresses and singers and politicians and rappers; we want to take part in the sins here, and those of us that don't, or aren't talented enough, still take part: celebrate their holidays, do what they say, Thanksgiving on the last Thursday of November because America says this is how you celebrate. They say forget about slavery, it's old, 1619 was a long time ago; well, when was Thanksgiving set up? 1620. Isn't that old? We have to forget slavery from 1619 to 1875, yet we celebrate Thanksgiving established in 1620. It is all hypocrisy. “and that ye receive not of her plagues.” You will receive the plagues here if you take part in the sins of Babylon. Notice it says plagues: the same plagues we read about in Exodus are coming here, twofold, threefold, like the plague of locusts in Revelation 9. We are seeing the plagues; we are just not seeing the spiritual understanding of what Revelation is talking about.
